text.en:
Repeal. All orders, circular, memoranda, rules, regulations and other
issuances or parts thereof inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed, modified or amended
accordingly.

Separability. If any part or provision of this Executive Order is held
invalid or unconstitutional, other provisions not affected thereby shall remain in force and

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila this 11thday of August
Two Thousand and Eleven.
in the year of our Lord
By the President:
PAQUITO N. OCHOA, JR.
Executive Secretary,
